title: Australian Mushroom Dumplings
description: Hearty and flavorful dumplings filled with sautéed mushrooms and served with a rich, creamy sauce.
instructions: Combine flour and water in a large bowl to make dumpling wrappers. Knead dough for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into small balls and roll out into thin circles.
In a separate pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add sliced onion and cook until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender. Season with soy sauce and Shaoxing wine.
Place a spoonful of mushroom mixture onto a dumpling wrapper. Fold and seal the wrapper.
Pan-fry dumplings until golden brown on bottom.
Serve with decadent sauce and garnish with sliced scallions.
Cook dumplings in boiling water for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve with steamed vegetables and a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
